_metadata.description: HTTP/CLI API for other agents to request tidiness recommendations

requirements.title: Scenario summary endpoint
requirements.description: Expose API endpoint to request top N tidiness issues for a given scenario

validation.notes: Unit tests passing - TestAgentGetIssues_BasicScenarioQuery, TestAgentGetIssues_LimitParameter validate endpoint behavior

requirements.title: File-scoped issue query
requirements.description: Support querying issues scoped to specific file or folder

validation.notes: Unit tests passing - TestAgentGetIssues_FileFilter, TestAgentGetIssues_FolderFilter validate file and folder scoping

requirements.title: Category-scoped issue query
requirements.description: Support querying issues filtered by category (e.g., 'long files', 'dead code')

validation.notes: Unit tests passing - TestAgentGetIssues_CategoryFilter validates category-based filtering

requirements.title: Issue ranking heuristic
requirements.description: Rank returned issues by severity, occurrence count, and file criticality

requirements.title: CLI wrapper for agent integration
requirements.description: Provide CLI commands that wrap HTTP API for agent consumption

requirements.title: Issue storage in postgres
requirements.description: Store issues in postgres with all required fields (scenario, file, category, severity, notes, remediation, campaign metadata)

requirements.title: Campaign metadata linkage
requirements.description: Link issues to campaign ID, session ID, and visit timestamp
